title: A 3-Metre Worm Hides in the Sand and Slices Fish in Half

scenes.text: A worm buried in the sand can slice its prey in half.
It's the bobbit worm, and it grows up to three metres long.
It buries itself and leaves only its antennae sticking out.
It uses them to sense anything swimming close.
Then it lunges out of the sand and snaps its jaws shut.
Most of the worm was hiding the whole time.

description:
A worm buried in the sand can slice its prey in half.
The bobbit worm grows up to three metres long, hides in the sediment with only its antennae showing, and lunges when prey swims close.
Would you swim over the sand after this?
